construction_markdown: No new code is claimed. The audited constructions are the complete-output parity lifts from Ta-Shma’s s-wide replacement product and Cohen–Cohen’s Gray-register product. Every lifted column is an XOR of base columns, so amplification cannot increase rank. The obstruction is strengthened to balanced-core rank 1040: such a core, together with the all-one word, would already produce a dimension-1041 target code.

distance_audit: A `tau`-balanced core has every nonzero weight in `[535,822,336,537,919,488]`. Its all-one augmentation has the same minimum-distance lower bound because the new coset consists of complements.
The obstruction concerns the published absolute-bias certificates. It does not prove that every underlying path multiset fails the weaker one-sided distance condition.
Deleting `M-n` uncontrolled coordinates from a raw absolute-bias certificate can prove the target only if `M≤n+2^21=1,075,838,976`. The strengthened barriers remain outside this window.
explicitness_audit: The complete-cloud constructions are symbolically enumerable, but their certified finite parameter choices exceed the exact length budget.
Deduplicating or selecting a sparse subset changes the path distribution and therefore cannot reuse the published operator-norm proof automatically.
Any sparse replacement must deterministically specify every graph, rotation map, starting state, path, multiplicity, and ordering, and output all generator entries in `n^{O(1)}` time.
Exhaustive subset selection or conditional-expectation search over path families is inadmissible.

generator_matrix.runtime_proof: There are 31n emitted bits. Coordinate lookup is constant time after indexing, and lexicographic column incrementation costs O(log n), giving O(n log n). This baseline algorithm is not a new submission.

obstructions: A 1040-dimensional balanced core is already enough to beat the campaign-proved dimension-1040 code after all-one augmentation, closing an off-by-one scope gap in the prior rank-1041 barrier.
Ta-Shma’s complete-output Theorem 4.1 has no contracting specialization of balanced-core rank at least 1040 within the exact or generically puncturable length window.
Cohen–Cohen’s complete Gray-register certificate at rank at least 1040 requires at least 16,722,507,176,960 output coordinates when the inner Cayley degree is included.
Parity-walk amplification never increases the span of the base labels.
These are certificate and complete-enumeration obstructions, not impossibility results for deterministic sparse path families or direct one-sided analyses.

proof_markdown:
## Rank-1040 complete-cloud obstruction

Put `N=2^30`, `tau=2^-9`, and `D=(1-tau)N/2`. A `tau`-balanced binary code `B` has every nonzero weight in `[D,N-D]`. Since `1^N∉B`, the code `B⊕<1^N>` has dimension `dim(B)+1`; its new coset consists of complements and therefore still has minimum distance at least `D`. Thus balanced-core rank 1040 already suffices to produce a dimension-1041 leaderboard improvement.

Every parity-walk output column is an XOR of base labels. Hence its span is contained in the base-label span. A balanced output of dimension at least 1040 therefore requires at least 1040 outer vertices.

For an undirected `q`-regular rotation multigraph on `v` vertices with normalized nontrivial eigenvalue magnitude at most `lambda`, integral adjacency multiplicities give

`tr(P^2)≥v/q`.

Spectral decomposition gives `tr(P^2)≤1+(v-1)lambda^2`; consequently

`q≥v/[1+(v-1)lambda^2]`.  (1)

For Ta-Shma’s complete output, `M=N_1D_1^sD_2^t`. Blind puncturing based only on raw absolute bias requires `M≤(1+tau)N`. Since `N_1≥1040`, this implies `D_1^s<2^20`. If `t<s`, the theorem’s exponent is zero. For `s≤3`, its block factor is at least one. If `4≤s≤9`, then `D_1≤31`; (1) gives

`lambda_1^2≥1009/(31·1039)>1/36`.

Compatibility forces `lambda_2^2≥2lambda_1>1/3`, and the block factor satisfies

`Q≥s^2lambda_2^(s-3)>s^2·3^{-(s-3)/2}≥3`.

If `s≥10`, then `D_1≤3`, and (1) gives `lambda_1^2>(1/4)`. Compatibility would require `lambda_2^2≥2lambda_1>1`, impossible. Thus the published Ta-Shma estimate never gives a subunit certificate in the relevant rank-length window.

For Cohen–Cohen, a target norm certificate `10(2omega_H)^(ell-2)≤1/512` forces `ell≥3` and `omega_H<1/2`. Its compatibility inequality then implies `omega_G<1/40`. Applying (1) to the outer graph with `v≥1040` yields

`d>1600v/(v+1599)≥1600·1040/2639>630`,

so `d≥631`. Double-conflict-freeness on intervals forces `s≥3`: every length-two interval uses distinct symbols, while a three-letter word over only two symbols has only one uniquely occurring symbol.

The inner Cayley graph has `d^s>9` vertices, degree `c`, and spectral expansion below `1/2`. Applying (1) again gives

`c>4d^s/(d^s+3)>3`,

hence `c≥4`. Therefore its complete output length is at least

`v d^s c^ell ≥1040·631^3·4^3=16,722,507,176,960>N`.

Accordingly neither published complete-output certificate can supply a balanced core capable of beating dimension 1040. Sparse or support-aware variants require a new proof. ∎

proof_steps.proof: A `tau`-balanced core excludes `1^n`. Every word in its all-one coset is a complement, so its weight remains in `[D,n-D]`.
proof_steps.statement: A balanced core of dimension 1040 yields a dimension-1041 target code after all-one augmentation.

proof_steps.proof: Integral adjacency multiplicities give `tr(P^2)≥v/q`; the spectral decomposition gives `tr(P^2)≤1+(v-1)lambda^2`.

At rank 1040, the exact/generic-puncturing length window still gives `D_1^s<2^20`. The cases `s≤3`, `4≤s≤9`, and `s≥10` respectively give block factor at least one, block factor above three, and incompatible spectral hypotheses.
proof_steps.statement: Ta-Shma Theorem 4.1 has no contracting complete-output specialization capable of a 1040-dimensional balanced core.

proof_steps.proof: The target norm forces `ell≥3` and `omega_H<1/2`; compatibility and the outer trace bound force `d≥631`. Double-conflict-freeness forces `s≥3`, while the inner trace bound forces `c≥4`.
proof_steps.statement: Cohen–Cohen’s complete Gray-register output has length at least `16,722,507,176,960` at core rank 1040.

research_direction: Wide replacement products and Gray-code constructions
theorem_statement: Let `tau=2^-9`. Neither Ta-Shma’s complete s-wide construction nor Cohen–Cohen’s complete Gray-register construction, using their published norm certificates, can produce a `tau`-balanced binary linear core of dimension at least 1040 at length at most `2^30`, even allowing blind puncturing justified solely by raw absolute bias. Hence their standard complete-output forms cannot beat the dimension-1040 campaign endpoint by adjoining the all-one word.
title: Rank-1040 tightening of the wide-replacement and Gray-register barriers
